title: Fly With the Wind and writing for strings
summary: Tyner and Aisha credit Bill Fischer for the string arrangements on Fly With the Wind.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Watch out for that plant behind you.

That’s OK, don’t worry about it. Don’t worry about that plant, it’s not going any where . . . it’s not even alive (laughs). Maybe it is but I think it’s going to be OK. Again, I would be remiss if I didn’t mention Fly With The Wind because strings . . . orchestrating for strings. We both know, as an arranger myself, that’s a different animal writing for strings. So how did you prepare for a project like that?
I wanted to do something like that and I think I mentioned that to . . .
When he did the strings on Fly With The Wind, Bill did that didn’t he?
Yeah Bill Fischer, because Bill’s experience was very broad.
